summary: Man found dehydrated and vomiting at the bottom of the Warner Route; a park ranger hiked down and spent the night with him; the next morning a medevac helicopter evacuated him from the canyon bottom while the ranger led the rest of the party back up.
location: Warner Route, Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park rangers
notes: Date inferred: ProRanger student blog post dated Fri 2020-07-24 narrates the prior Fri-Sun weekend; the report and overnight ranger stay were Sat 2020-07-18, the medevac helicopter evacuation Sun 2020-07-19. Filed on the Saturday report date. Inserted run 1016 (NPS BLCA chunk).
